description: The thermal pipe contact model models a one-dimensional pipe with a thermal resistance per unit length of η .

property_groups.name: Thermal Pipe Group
property_groups.description: Live-enumerated on PFC3D 9.7 via the cmat property slot.

properties.description: Thermal resistance per unit length (the model's defining parameter).

notes: Thermal option model. Properties documented under the PFC thermal option manual.

Assignment grammar (live 6.0/7.0/9.7): the thermal CMAT uses a process selector - 'contact cmat thermal default model thermalpipe'. Requires 'model configure thermal'. The thermal model-name slot enumerates exactly: null thermalpipe; the thermalpipe property slot enumerates exactly: temperature thexp thres.

Python access (live 6.0 and 9.7): itasca.contact.list('thermal') - the first argument of contact.list is process_name (default 'Mechanical'), so a bare list() returns mechanical contacts only. Returned objects are Ball*ThermalContact types (see the ThermalContact SDK interface); props() reads temperature/thexp/thres. Command-side listing: 'contact thermal list' (process selector before the subcommand).
